title: echinaria capitata var. pumila
intro: Echinaria capitata var. pumila, commonly known as Dwarf Purple Coneflower or Small Purple Coneflower, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant health benefits, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Echinaria capitata var. pumila include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpene lactones, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
